Research result:

Relevant excerpts from the configured [Discord Gateway documentation](https://docs.discord.com/developers/events/gateway.md):

1. Reconnect and resume procedure:
“If an app **can** resume/reconnect, it should open a new connection using 'resume_gateway_url' with the same version and encoding, then send a [Resume (opcode '6')](https://docs.discord.com/developers/events/gateway-events#resume) event.”

2. Connection termination instruction:
“The client should immediately terminate the connection with any close code besides '1000' or '1001', then reconnect and attempt to [Resume](https://docs.discord.com/developers/events/gateway.md#resuming).”

3. Resume versus a fresh session:
“When your app encounters a disconnect, it will typically be sent a [close code](https://docs.discord.com/developers/topics/opcodes-and-status-codes.md#gateway-gateway-close-event-codes) which can be used to determine whether you can reconnect and [Resume](https://docs.discord.com/developers/events/gateway.md#resuming) the session, or whether you have to start over and re-Identify.”

Taken together, these excerpts support a conditional recovery flow: inspect the disconnect close code; if the session is resumable, reconnect using resume_gateway_url with the original version and encoding and send opcode 6; otherwise, sta

rt over with Identify. The termination instruction in excerpt 2 should be applied only in its original triggering context, which was not included in the supplied extract.

Configured source: https://docs.discord.com/developers/events/gateway.md — supplied excerpt specifies resume_gateway_url, unchanged version and encoding, and Resume opcode 6.

Configured source: https://docs.discord.com/developers/events/gateway.md#resuming — supplied excerpt distinguishes resumable disconnects from those requiring re-Identify.

Linked close-code reference: https://docs.discord.com/developers/topics/opcodes-and-status-codes.md#gateway-gateway-close-event-codes — referenced by the supplied documentation; its contents were not supplied or independently retrieved.

Limitations:
- Analysis is grounded in the supplied configured-source excerpts; the live documentation was not independently verified.
- The triggering context for the immediate-termination excerpt is missing, so it cannot establish a universal disconnect rule.
- The supplied excerpts do not enumerate close-code handling, Resume payload fields, retry timing, or invalid-session behavior.
